STIMMYZ · DESIGN REFERENCE

Minimal screens + gallery artwork

The approved transparent glossy “Stimmyz ✦” logo is used on all three screens. The glossy transparent logo sits directly on all themes. Artwork uses only your device gallery; no image-search API is needed.

Interaction contract
Quick Add is always position #1 and defaults to Record device audio. It has no arrow outside Edit Board. Pad ⋮ appears only during Edit Board. Each board independently supports Pages or Scroll. Library ⋮ is always available. Sound boost and looping are per-clip. The three-tab navigation stays unchanged. Gallery artwork is local and works offline.

SCREEN CHECKLIST

All buttons, menus, theme switches, and sample gallery selection are interactive. Actual gallery requests, licensing permission, audio processing, and media files are not included.

The sample pad thumbnails are crops from AI-generated concept artwork, included for design comparison only. Do not distribute them in a released app without checking the relevant rights.
